readings.Aries: The wound you keep reopening has something to teach. You've been treating the symptom. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Taurus: The loyalty you extend to others is real. It occasionally extends past the point of useful. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Gemini: You've told the story of yourself differently to different people. Which version is closest to true? The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Cancer: There is love in your life that is waiting to be acknowledged. Notice it. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Leo: Someone around you needs your strength, not your performance of strength. Know the difference. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Virgo: Something you've categorised as not-your-problem is actually exactly your problem. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Libra: The peace you've been keeping has a cost that's being charged somewhere else. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Scorpio: Your perception of betrayal is accurate. What you do with that perception is still yours to decide. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Sagittarius: You've been talking about the future in a way that lets you avoid the present. Notice this. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Capricorn: The reputation you've built is accurate. There are parts of you it doesn't include. Show one of them. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Aquarius: You are most difficult when you're most certain. Today, hold your certainty lightly. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Pisces: The distance between what you feel and what you say is large today. Try to close it. There's more support available than you've asked for.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
